findings.evidence: Symmetries.lean:246-273; none of the four statements or proofs mentions `Frag`, `favored`, `unfavored` or any `Fragmentation` declaration. ValenceContent.lean:78 already holds the sibling `image_conj_valence` with the same `[DecidableEq Flavor]` hypothesis.
findings.fix: Move all four to `EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/ValenceContent.lean` as public theorems next to `ValenceContent.image_conj_valence` (e.g. `ValenceContent.image_conj_inter_valence`, `ValenceContent.image_conj_sdiff_valence`, `ValenceContent.IsValenceFlavor.inter_valence_conj_eq_sdiff`, `.sdiff_valence_conj_eq_inter`), adding any Finset import needed, and drop the `private` copies.
findings.issue: `image_conj_inter_valence` (246), `image_conj_sdiff_valence` (252), `inter_valence_conj_eq_sdiff` (258) and `sdiff_valence_conj_eq_inter` (269) are `private` here, but their statements mention only `ValenceContent`, `Species.flavorPair`, `Species.conj` and `Finset`, and their proofs use only `Finset.image_inter`/`image_sdiff`, `Species.image_conj_flavorPair`, `C.image_conj_valence`, `C.mem_valence_conj`, `IsValenceFlavor.quark_mem_iff`/`antiquark_mem_iff` — nothing about fragmentation. They are general valence-content infrastructure hidden in a consumer file.

findings.evidence: Symmetries.lean:93 `variable {D : Frag Hadron (Species Flavor)} …`; 165 `variable (C : ValenceContent Hadron Flavor) (D)`; 215 `have := favored_add_unfavored D C h i z Q2` — `D` is passed first, opposite to `favored C D h i z Q2` at 155-157.
findings.fix: Declare the variables so the lemmas match the definitions: move the `D` variable declaration after `C` (or state `(C) (D)` explicitly in each lemma) so every public lemma reads `favored_def C D h i z Q2`, and make `favored_nonneg`/`unfavored_nonneg` consistent with it.
findings.issue: The explicit-argument order of the lemmas contradicts the definitions. `favored`/`unfavored` take `C` then `D` (155, 161), but `variable (C : ValenceContent Hadron Flavor) (D)` at 165 only re-binds the `D` declared at 93, so `D` keeps its earlier position: `favored_def`, `unfavored_def` and `favored_add_unfavored` are applied as `… D C h i z Q2` (see the call at 215). `favored_nonneg`/`unfavored_nonneg` (183, 188) re-bind `{D}` locally and so take `C` then implicit `D` — a third order.

findings.evidence: Grep of the file shows `favored_eq_apply_quark`, `favored_eq_apply_antiquark`, `unfavored_eq_apply_antiquark`, `unfavored_eq_apply_quark` only (196-226); no lemma whose hypotheses are two memberships or two non-memberships.
findings.fix: Add the two missing cases: for `Species.quark i ∈ C.valence h` and `Species.antiquark i ∈ C.valence h`, `favored C D h i z Q2 = D h (.quark i) z Q2 + D h (.antiquark i) z Q2` and `unfavored … = 0`; for neither in `C.valence h`, `favored … = 0` and `unfavored … = D h (.quark i) z Q2 + D h (.antiquark i) z Q2`.
findings.issue: The characteristic API of `favored`/`unfavored` covers only the `IsValenceFlavor` case (196-242). There is no lemma for the two degenerate cases, although the module docstring (39-41) and `not_isValenceFlavor_pion_zero` advertise the flavour-neutral one: a consumer cannot evaluate `favored pionContent D .zero i` or `unfavored pionContent D .zero i` without unfolding `favored_def` and computing the `Finset` intersection by hand.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:191-198 defines `Invariant` and `invariant_iff` only; Symmetries.lean:357 `rw [Invariant, valenceStepFrag_def, comap_indicatorUnitInterval]`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem invariant_def : Invariant τ σ D ↔ comap τ σ D = D := Iff.rfl` in Basic.lean and rewrite with it at Symmetries.lean:357 instead of `rw [Invariant]`.
findings.issue: `Invariant` is given only the pointwise `invariant_iff`; there is no restatement of its defining equation, so the downstream file unfolds the definition body with `rw [Invariant]` (Symmetries.lean:357) instead of using API. The other definitions in this PR all carry such a restatement (`partonConj_eq_comap`, `favored_def`, `valenceStepFrag_def`).

summary: Four general `ValenceContent`/`Species` facts are hidden as `private` inside the fragmentation file instead of living public in their canonical home, the `favored`/`unfavored` lemmas take their arguments in the opposite order from the definition, the characteristic API stops at the `IsValenceFlavor` case so the flavour-neutral case the file advertises can only be computed by unfolding, and `Invariant` has no `*_def` restatement so a downstream file unfolds its body.
